name: vacuum_cost_page_miss
description: Cost assigned when VACUUM must read a data page from disk (i.e., buffer cache miss) during cleanup or freeze operations.
symptoms: Vacuum falling behind leading to bloat
High latency for concurrent queries during vacuum
Uncontrolled vacuum CPU and I/O consumption
tuning_tips: Increase cautiously (e.g., +5–10) to speed up vacuum on I/O-rich systems with spare disk bandwidth; decrease (e.g., to 1–5) to throttle vacuum I/O impact on latency-sensitive workloads. Always tune in concert with vacuum_cost_limit and vacuum_cost_delay.
